headline: Petrobras Valuation Hits $148 Billion Ahead of Lula Term
summary: Petrobras, Brazil's state-controlled oil giant, reached a market valuation near $148 billion on October 14, 2026, as President Lula prepares for a new term.
why: Petrobras is one of Latin America's largest energy corporations, and its valuation is sensitive to state policies and commodity price cycles.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Petrobras reached a market valuation near $148 billion.
